messages:
Priya (Product): Heads-up: large EU customer wants guaranteed regional capacity in eu-west + latency SLOs. Pricing tied to commit. Any immediate blockers?
Dmitri (Infra): Clarify tenancy: do they need fully isolated GPUs or reservation within a shared pool?
Priya (Product): They said 'data-isolated and region-locked'—sounds strong.
Aisha (Eng-Platform): That implies dedicated pool or at least VPC-anchored Dedicated. KMS + network controls needed.
Ben (Architecture): Two product paths: RegionSlice (soft isolation, faster, cheaper) or RegionDedicated (full isolation, higher cost, longer lead).
Olivia (SRE): Also confirm failover policy. They said no automatic cross-region failover without approval. That affects routing and runbooks.
Priya (Product): Correct — must document failover and allow only manual/approved actions.
Dmitri (Infra): Implementation sketch: tenant flag regional_lock="eu-west", tiers (small/med/large), short burst window with explicit auth, billing hooks for commits.
Aisha (Eng-Platform): Proposed launch criteria: provisioned slice/pod in eu-west, VPC/KMS validated, pinning + KV priming, chaos-tested runbook, pricing & cancellation terms.
Ben (Architecture): SLAs must be measured on customer workload snapshots (P50/P95/P99) and throughput per GPU.
Olivia (SRE): Ops must include emergency demotion to shared best-effort, throttles, and paging rules. Need minimal dashboard for pinned pool utilization and tail latency alerts.
Eve (Solutions Eng): Sales note: customer will accept RegionSlice if ~50% cheaper. They want an isolation-vs-price matrix for the deal.
Dmitri (Infra): Risks: capacity fragmentation and bin-packing inefficiencies. Consider eviction policy and a marketplace for idle commits.
Priya (Product): Prioritization: Ship RegionSlice MVP to close deal quickly and run parallel work to deliver RegionDedicated later. What's minimal effort to hit end-of-Q3?
Dmitri (Infra): MVP plan: 2 infra sprints (templated pod + quota), 1 runtime sprint (pinning + metrics), 1 SRE sprint (runbook + chaos) — ~6-8 weeks if resourced.
Aisha (Eng-Platform): Lead times: Slice ~2 weeks; Dedicated ~4-6 weeks.
Ben (Architecture): Action items: define SLA matrix, measurement plan, and clear failover semantics.
Olivia (SRE): I'll draft runbook and dashboard spec.
Dmitri (Infra): I'll send cost and lead-time estimates for Dedicated pod Tue.
Priya (Product): I'll draft customer offer with migration clause and coordinate legal.
Eve (Solutions Eng): Sales will use Slice with migration path.
